title: Join slices of a quasicategory project by right fibrations
statement: Use simplicial sets, quasicategories, horns, Kan complexes, right-pinched mapping spaces and weak contractibility as in [def-cbc-enhanced-diagrams-cones]. For simplicial sets $X,Y$ put $(X\star Y)_r=X_r\amalg Y_r\amalg\coprod_{u+v+1=r}X_u\times Y_v$, with operators restricting the ordered concatenation of the $X$-vertices followed by the $Y$-vertices. Let $\mathcal C$ be a quasicategory, $K$ any small simplicial set, and $p:K\to\mathcal C$ a simplicial map. Define $(\mathcal C_{/p})_n$ to consist of maps $\sigma:\Delta^n\star K\to\mathcal C$ restricting to $p$ on $K$, with operators given by precomposition with $\Delta(\alpha)\star\operatorname{id}_K$. Restriction to $\Delta^n$ defines $q:\mathcal C_{/p}\to\mathcal C$. Then $\mathcal C_{/p}$ is a quasicategory and $q$ is a right fibration: every commutative square against $\Lambda_i^n\hookrightarrow\Delta^n$, for $n\geq1$ and $0<i\leq n$, admits a lift. In the case $K=\Delta^0$ and $p=t$, write this slice as $\mathcal C_{/t}$. For every vertex $x\in\mathcal C$, the degreewise fiber of $q$ over the constant simplicial subset $\{x\}$ is exactly $\operatorname{Map}_{\mathcal C}(x,t)$, and is a Kan complex. In particular these are the right-pinched mapping spaces, without replacing them by hom sets in the homotopy category.
